Name: Soup's Jelly and More
Author: dreamofsoup
Description:
[code]﻿SDV 1.6 Update Note:

Now updated for 1.6! Use an old file version if you're still on 1.5

Honey is new! But jelly color options are gone now. Let me know if you'd like 'em back.[/code]

[b]---[/b]

[b]HOW TO USE THIS MOD

[/b]Jelly, pickles, and honey will all be replaced by default. To see vanilla (base-game) sprites, use the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098http://]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ or edit the config.json file. 

This mod is a content pack that [b]requires[/b] the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] mod to run. This mod does nothing without Content Patcher installed. 

[b]---
[/b]
[b]HOW TO INSTALL THIS MOD[/b]
Check the Stardew Valley Wiki modding guide for users to see where to put this mod's folder!
[url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started
[/url]﻿
If you're still struggling, I recommend the #using-mods-help discussion in the Stardew Valley (almost official) discord server.
[url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]https://discord.gg/stardewvalley[/url]
